serverInfo.name: OneDrive-PluginEditor
serverInfo.title: OneDrive Agent Plugin Editor
serverInfo.description: Create and maintain portable Agent Plugins in the user's personal OneDrive /plugins folder.

instructions: Author and maintain Agent Plugins v1.0.0 under /plugins in the user's default OneDrive. Keep each plugin folder name equal to its immutable plugin.json name. Use dedicated manifest and MCP entry tools for plugin.json and mcp.json; use package-file tools only for other files. Add Agent Skills only by snapshotting a complete validated OneDrive/SharePoint shared folder or ZIP link into skills/<name>/, and remove skills only through the dedicated skill tool. Inspect after mutations and preserve independent valid components when another component is invalid.
